page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Below the last line, a gathering signature "H" stands at the foot. A reference in the left margin sits beside the first paragraph.

main_text.p: & nube verborum suorum, simplices quoque credentium opprimere & operire festinant. In 38. cap.

Congregant divitias dogmatum in malum suum, & necrepertores utilitatem aliquā pos-sunt consequi, nec sectatoribus suis fructu re-linquere perpetuum: sed & ipsi & discipuli re-vertuntur in terram, & perdunt divitias ab eo qui dixit, Perdam sapientiam sapientium, & prudentiam prudentium reprobabo. Tom.5.in 5. caput Ecclesiastis.

Sagena eorum est sermo affabilis, blandum eloquium, simulata aut coacta ieiunia; vestis humilis, virtutum imitatio. Quod si coeperint de superioribus disputare, & in sublime levare os suum, & Dei altitudines quaerere, laqueum ponunt in excelsis. In cap.9. Ecclesiastis.

Vino inebriantur, quando Scripturas san-ctas male intelligunt atque perveruunt: sicera, quando saeculari abutuntur sapientia & Diale-cticorum tendiculis, quae non tam vincula sunt appellanda quam umbrae quaedam & imagi-nes, quae cito pereunt atque solvuntur. Istiusmodi consiliarios maledictio poslidebit[?], qui quaestum putant esse pietatem, & cuncta faciunt propter avaritiam. Tom.4.lib.9. (comm.in-28.cap.Esaiae.
Dictum illud, Omnes mensae eorum repletae

page.notes: Right margin: a few stray marks and a vertical stroke, not printed text, left out. The "H" at the foot is a gathering signature. Doubtful: "poslidebit" (the printed letters read poslidebit; the likely word is possidebit, so the form is kept as printed and marked). "aliquā" has a mark over the a that may be a macron or circumflex. The left margin reference "In 38. cap." is set beside the first paragraph. Reference "Tom.4.lib.9. (comm.in-" ends in a printed hyphen before "28.cap.Esaiae.".
